prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Houston for a car wreck?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single, objective “best” personal injury lawyer for every car wreck — the right lawyer depends on your case details and preferences. I can help you find strong options, but first here’s how to choose and what to check.

Quick checklist of what to look for
- Experience with car wrecks and similar injuries (not just general PI).
- Trial experience (most good cases settle, but you want someone who will go to court if needed).
- Track record of settlements/verdicts for cases like yours.
- Clear contingency-fee agreement (typical 33%–40% if settled before suit; often higher if suit/appeal required).
- Good client communication and a dedicated point of contact.
- No disciplinary actions with the State Bar of Texas.
- Local presence in Houston and familiarity with local judges, courts, and medical providers.

Red flags
- Pressure to accept the insurer’s first offer.
- No written fee agreement.
- Poor responsiveness or evasive answers about experience/results.
- Bad reviews mentioning missed deadlines or lack of follow-through.

Important practical notes
- Texas statute of limitations for personal injury (including car wrecks) is generally 2 years from the date of the crash — don’t wait too long to consult an attorney.
- Preserve evidence (photos, medical records), and note witnesses while memories are fresh.

Questions to ask at a free consultation
- How many car wreck cases like mine have you handled?
- How many have gone to trial? What were the results?
- Who in your office will handle my case day-to-day?
- What is your fee and how are costs handled if we lose?
- What do you estimate the case value is and timeline to resolution?

How I can help now
If you want, tell me:
- Your Houston ZIP code (or neighborhood),
- A short summary of the crash (date, injuries, fault/insurance issues),
and I’ll compile a short list of well‑rated local personal injury lawyers/firms and recent client reviews you can contact for consultations.
